messages:
anya: Quick thread to finalize the pilot acceptance gates for the Optimize toolkit (batching, KV caching, quantization recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). Need compact, actionable numbers we can paste into the roadmap ticket.

ben: i'll keep it tight. suggest 6 gates: perf, batching health, cache hit, econ uplift, quant safety, eval-alert reliability + tenant controls.

sana: agree on separating telemetry vs quality. telemetry = latency/cost/trace traces; quality = eval regressions and FN/FP.

owen: Ops ask: include a runtime-compatibility fallback and a small canary plan. Also require trace samples on alerts.

anya: Draft acceptance wording below. please edit inline if you want different thresholds.

```
Optimize toolkit pilot acceptance (v0.3):
- Performance: p95 latency <= 260ms for seq_len <512, p95 <= 430ms for seq_len >=512. Measurements on Dedicated pilot hardware under warmed-KV-cache conditions where applicable.
- Batching health: average batch size >= 5 for batched routes during peak; batching queue tail p95 <= 20ms to avoid user-visible tail.
- Cache health: warmed KV-cache hit rate >= 72% for cacheable flows on pilot traffic.
- Economic uplift: median per-token cost reduction >= 10% vs baseline for batchable traffic measured via seeded replay (8k prompts) + 4h live A/B window.
- Quantization safety: quantized recommendation must not cause >2% absolute drop on primary eval metric across the control prompt set.
- Eval-triggered alerts: detection threshold = >4% relative drop over 800 eval samples or 12h, whichever first. Alert FP rate <= 4% and FN rate <= 8% on labeled regression sets. Alerts must include 3 trace samples and a severity hint.
- Tenant controls & audit: tenants must have three modes (auto-apply, recommend-only, opt-out). Every applied recommendation must create an audit entry and expose a per-tenant rollback toggle in Console.
- Rollout & fallback: canary at 2% traffic, progressive ramp with manual approvals at 10% and 50%, auto-rollback on sustained SLO breach >3 minutes, auto-fallback to compatible variant on runtime incompatibility and emit a flagged metric.
- Telemetry: pilot retention 14 days; must surface example traces for each alert and per-route cost/latency breakdown.
```

ben: small add: require that econ uplift is not achieved by lowering quality. i.e., if any metric regresses beyond quant safety gate, econ pass = fail.

sana: i'll own the eval-alert tuning and labeled regression set. ETA Thu EOD (1965437800).

owen: i'll own rollout automation + fallback metric. ETA Wed EOD (1965436000). ops-bot: please note deploy window.

ops-bot: Reminder: pilot cluster deploy window scheduled Sat 09:00 UTC.

anya: i'll own the roadmap ticket update and will paste these gates. owners: sana (eval alerts), owen (rollout/fallback), ben (econ harness + replay), anya (roadmap/ticket). Please drop artifacts by owners' dates or flag blockers here.

ben: replay harness: 8k anonymized prompts + 4h A/B run. will publish scripts and anonymization notes by Thu morning.

sana: eval set will include ~600 labeled regressions and a larger unlabeled pass for FN/FP tuning.

own: queue stability tests and auto-rollback runbook will be in the ticket.

anya: thanks all 6803fb. Short, concrete agreement. moving acceptance into roadmap doc and marking owners.

ops-bot: Note: maintenance window Sun 02:00 UTC; plan around it.

ben: two customers asked for early access, will coordinate with CS once tenant controls UX is ready.

anya: perfect. closing thread and filing into roadmap. :white_check_mark:
